requirements.payer: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield
requirements.summary: Radiographs must have been obtained and be nondiagnostic before advanced imaging of the knee.
requirements.quote: Advanced imaging is considered medically necessary following nondiagnostic radiographs
requirements.document_title: Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Imaging of the Extremities

requirements.payer: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield
requirements.summary: Either mechanical symptoms with at least two meniscal exam findings, or at least one exam finding with 6 weeks of failed conservative management.
requirements.quote: Knee pain with symptoms of locking, catching, or instability AND at least TWO of the following physical exam findings of meniscal tear [...] Knee pain with at least ONE physical exam finding of meniscal tear and failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative management
requirements.document_title: Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Imaging of the Extremities

requirements.payer: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield
requirements.summary: 4 weeks of failed conservative management, unless preoperative stress testing is positive.
requirements.quote: Failure of at least 4 weeks of conservative management
requirements.document_title: Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Imaging of the Extremities

requirements.summary: An in-person clinical evaluation for the current episode must precede advanced imaging.
requirements.quote: An in-person clinical evaluation for the current episode of the condition is required to have been performed before advanced imaging is considered.
requirements.document_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Radiology: Spine Imaging Guidelines, Low Back (Lumbar Spine) Pain without Neurological Features (SP-5.1)

requirements.summary: 6-week trial of provider-directed treatment must have failed, unless a red flag indication is present.
requirements.quote: Failure of a 6-week trial of provider-directed treatment after the current set of symptoms or physical exam findings started or changed (unless presence of a red flag as defined in Red Flag Indications (SP-1.2))
requirements.document_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Radiology: Spine Imaging Guidelines, Low Back (Lumbar Spine) Pain without Neurological Features (SP-5.1)

requirements.summary: Clinical re-evaluation must occur after the treatment period.
requirements.quote: Clinical re-evaluation after treatment period (may consist of an in-person evaluation or other meaningful contact)
requirements.document_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Radiology: Spine Imaging Guidelines, Low Back (Lumbar Spine) Pain without Neurological Features (SP-5.1)

requirements.summary: Objective motor or reflex findings in the nerve root distribution plus no improvement after 6 weeks of conservative therapy.
requirements.quote: Persistent back or neck pain with radiculopathy as evidenced by pain plus objective findings of motor or reflex changes in the specific nerve root distribution, and no improvement after 6 weeks of conservative therapy
requirements.document_title: Clinical Policy Bulletin 0236: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT) of the Spine

requirements.summary: Has not responded to 4 weeks of conservative therapy.
requirements.quote: Spondylolisthesis and degenerative disease of the spine that has not responded to 4 weeks of conservative therapy
requirements.document_title: Clinical Policy Bulletin 0236: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT) of the Spine

requirements.payer: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield
requirements.summary: 6 weeks of conservative management must have been tried and failed.
requirements.quote: Pain or radiculopathy (including chronic neurogenic claudication) following at least 6 weeks of conservative management (imaging no more than annually)
requirements.document_title: Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Imaging of the Spine
requirements.section_id: Imaging of the Spine — Low back pain or lumbar radiculopathy

requirements.payer: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield
requirements.summary: Neurologic exam findings suggesting nerve root or cord compression, not previously imaged or new since the last imaging.
requirements.quote: Neurologic exam findings suggesting lumbar nerve root or cord compression that has not previously been imaged or is new since last imaging was performed
requirements.document_title: Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Imaging of the Spine
requirements.section_id: Imaging of the Spine — Low back pain or lumbar radiculopathy

requirements.payer: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield
requirements.summary: At least one concerning headache feature must be documented.
requirements.quote: Advanced imaging is considered medically necessary to evaluate headache not previously imaged by MRI in ANY of the following scenarios
requirements.document_title: Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Imaging of the Brain

requirements.summary: Plain x-rays must have been performed after this episode of symptoms began, with results available to the requesting provider.
requirements.quote: Plain x-rays have been performed after the beginning of the current episode of symptoms started
requirements.document_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Radiology: Musculoskeletal Imaging Guidelines

requirements.summary: Six weeks of provider-directed conservative treatment, unless at least two of four listed exam criteria are documented instead.
requirements.quote: Failure of 6 weeks of provider-directed conservative treatment, including clinical re-evaluation, occurring after the current episode of symptoms started OR at least 2 of the following 4 criteria met
requirements.document_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Radiology: Musculoskeletal Imaging Guidelines

requirements.summary: Plain x-rays of the knee must have been performed after this episode of symptoms began or changed.
requirements.quote: Initial plain x-ray imaging of the suspected area must first be performed after the current episode of symptoms started or changed with results available to the requesting provider
requirements.document_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Radiology: Musculoskeletal Imaging Guidelines

requirements.summary: Six weeks of provider-directed conservative treatment, unless an instability test is positive compared with the other knee.
requirements.quote: Otherwise, failure of 6 weeks of provider-directed conservative treatment, including clinical re-evaluation, occurring after the current episode of symptoms started is required
requirements.document_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Radiology: Musculoskeletal Imaging Guidelines

requirements.summary: A focal neurological deficit or a published red-flag feature must be documented; imaging is not indicated for primary headache without one.
requirements.quote: Advanced imaging of the head is NOT medically necessary for any of the following: Primary headache disorder in the absence of focal neurological deficits or “red flags”
requirements.document_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Radiology: Head Imaging Guidelines, Headache General Guidelines (HD-11.0)

requirements.summary: Three weeks of conservative therapy where the knee pain is not associated with an injury.
requirements.quote: Persistent knee pain/swelling and/or instability (giving way) when: Not associated with an injury and not responding to at least 3 weeks of conservative therapy
requirements.document_title: Clinical Policy Bulletin 0171: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) of the Extremities

requirements.summary: An initial plain x-ray must have been obtained and the results available to the provider.
requirements.quote: After an initial plain x-ray has been obtained, and results are available to the provider, the following advanced imaging is indicated
requirements.document_title: UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Exchange Plans: Cardiovascular and Radiology Imaging Guidelines, Knee (MS-25)

requirements.summary: Six weeks of provider-directed conservative treatment, unless at least two of four listed exam criteria are documented instead.
requirements.quote: Conservative treatment is not required if at least 2 of following 4 criteria are met: 1) Positive McMurray’s, positive Thessaly, or positive Apley’s Compression Test 2) twisting or acute injury of the knee 3) locked knee/inability to fully extend the knee on exam in comparison to the opposite knee 4) knee effusion
requirements.document_title: UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Exchange Plans: Cardiovascular and Radiology Imaging Guidelines, Knee (MS-25)

requirements.summary: A focal neurological deficit or a published red-flag feature must be documented; imaging is not indicated for primary headache without one.
requirements.quote: Advanced imaging of the head is NOT indicated for any of the following: Primary headache disorder in the absence of focal neurological deficits or "red flags"
requirements.document_title: UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Exchange Plans: Cardiovascular and Radiology Imaging Guidelines, Headache General Guidelines (HD-11.0)

requirements.summary: A six-week trial of provider-directed treatment within the last twelve weeks, unless a red flag is present.
requirements.quote: Failure of recent (within 12 weeks) 6-week trial of provider-directed treatment (unless presence of a red flag as defined in Red Flag Indications (SP-1.2))
requirements.document_title: UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Exchange Plans: Cardiovascular and Radiology Imaging Guidelines, Low Back (Lumbar Spine) Pain without Neurological Features (SP-5.1)
